history.prompt: Clean isometric cutaway illustration, technical drawing style, axonometric projection. A single high-performance workstation graphics card linked by thick braided power cables to a massive, heavy-duty power supply unit. Flat muted palette with a striking copper accent color on the power lines, thin consistent line weight. Recognizable hardware components with visible depth, unlabelled, set against a generous empty margin, architectural precision.

style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: Minimalist studio composition of a modular mechanical assembly on a weathered brushed steel surface. An interlocking arrangement featuring a heavy finned graphics compute block, an unlatched inspection gate, and a thick braided power cable connector. Extreme asymmetry, hero off-centre right with heavy negative space left. Matte muted palette, hard clean edges, tactile industrial materials. One directional key light throwing a long cast shadow to the left.
negative_prompt: text, typography, letters, numbers, wordmark, logo, human, face, hands, spheres, cubes, bare geometry
rationale: A modular mechanical assembly isolates the physical hardware and power requirements that make up the hidden costs of local fine-tuning, emphasizing the material reality behind abstract token math.
subject: a modular graphics compute block and power supply cable
composition: extreme asymmetry, hero off-centre right with heavy negative space left
alt_text: Heavy finned graphics compute block and thick braided power cable connector arranged on a brushed steel surface.
caption: The true test of local compute is often the power limit and the rented price you choose not to beat.
title: Compute Economics Power Hardware Assembly
